cases.title: Initiate drag event and capture product title and price
cases.description: Verify that dragging a product item (li element with draggable='true' and data-testid='product-item-1') successfully initiates a drag event and captures the product title from data-testid='product-title-1' and price from data-testid='product-price-1' for transfer.

cases.title: Verify drag transfer data payload for multiple distinct products
cases.description: Verify that dragging multiple distinct product items sequentially correctly captures and updates the transfer data payload with the respective titles and prices.

cases.title: Drop product item into drop area updates cart display
cases.description: Drag a product item (data-testid='product-item-1') and drop it into the designated drop area (id='div1', data-testid='drop-area'). Verify that the cart display automatically updates such that the product title appears in .box2, the unit price in .box3, and the quantity in .box1.

cases.title: Drop repeated product items increments quantity in cart
cases.description: Drag and drop the same product item (data-testid='product-item-1') multiple times into the designated drop area (id='div1', data-testid='drop-area'). Verify that the quantity in .box1 increments correctly to support repeated products.

cases.title: Calculate and Display Total Price with Proper Formatting
cases.description: Verify that the system calculates the total price by summing the prices of all products in the cart, formats the total to two decimal places with the appropriate currency symbol, and displays it correctly in the <div id="allMoney"> element.

cases.title: Handle High-Precision Decimals and Zero Prices in Total Calculation
cases.description: Verify that the total price calculation correctly handles items with zero price or prices requiring high-precision decimal rounding, ensuring the output in <div id="allMoney"> remains correctly formatted to two decimal places with the currency symbol.

opinions.feedback: All proposed test cases are distinct, well-defined, and adequately cover testability, distinct scenarios, and risk for the specified requirements.
All cases are clear, valid, and fully testable according to the provided requirements. No blockers found.

analysis.analysis: For requirement e2edev_bench_01-R-1: Normal scenario includes dragging a product item identified by data-testid='product-item-1' with draggable='true', initiating a drag event that correctly captures the product's title from data-testid='product-title-1' and price from data-testid='product-price-1' into the transfer data. Edge/Boundary scenarios include dragging multiple distinct product items sequentially. Abnormal scenarios include attempting to drag a non-draggable element or an item missing title or price attributes. Actionable missing scenarios include verifying drag transfer data payload contents for malformed product items. For requirement e2edev_bench_01-R-3: Normal scenario includes dropping product items (e.g., data-testid='product-item-1') into the drop area identified by id='div1' and data-testid='drop-area', updating the cart display with the product title in .box2, unit price in .box3, and quantity in .box1. Edge/Boundary scenarios include dropping the same repeated product multiple times to verify quantity incrementing in .box1. Abnormal scenarios include dropping an invalid element not belonging to the product list into the drop area. Actionable missing scenarios include verifying drop behavior when the drop area is obstructed or drag-over events are cancelled prematurely. For requirement e2edev_bench_01-R-5: Normal scenario includes calculating the total price of all products in the cart, formatting the result to two decimal places with the appropriate currency symbol (e.g., '$80.00'), and displaying it in the <div id='allMoney'> element. Edge/Boundary scenarios include cart containing items with zero price or high-precision decimals requiring rounding. Abnormal scenarios include cart containing corrupted price formats (e.g., non-numeric strings). Actionable missing scenarios include verifying dynamic updates to #allMoney when items are removed or updated in quantity.
